thesis: The speakers argue that the video game industry has been defined for the last 50 years by clear business models that guide where creativity flows, rather than creative visions rearranging business models around them. They illustrate this dynamic by explaining that in the packaged goods era, the goal of selling a disc and getting customers to return a year later necessitated planned obsolescence, which directly informed what content was put on the disk.
